delivery_methodology: The project will be executed using an AI-enabled agile approach characterized by short, time-boxed iterations with regular demonstrations and continuous client feedback. This iterative process allows for incremental delivery of features and timely adjustments based on evolving requirements.

AI tools will assist in drafting documentation, code generation, and testing, while human experts will review, integrate, and approve all outputs to ensure quality and alignment with client expectations. This collaborative approach enhances productivity and maintains rigorous quality standards throughout the project lifecycle.
executive_summary: Kalinaw Trading Corporation seeks to implement a comprehensive Human Resource Information System (HRIS) to streamline HR operations and enhance management oversight. This system aims to improve efficiency in employee data management, leave and attendance tracking, and reporting, thereby supporting better decision-making and operational control.

Exist Software Labs proposes a tailored HRIS solution that integrates key HR functions into a unified platform accessible via web and mobile browsers. The project will be delivered through a structured, iterative process ensuring alignment with client needs and culminating in a robust, cloud-hosted system that empowers Kalinaw Trading Corporation with real-time HR insights and self-service capabilities for employees.
proposed_solution: The proposed HRIS solution consolidates employee information management, leave and attendance tracking, payroll interfacing, and reporting into a single, user-friendly platform. Employees, HR staff, supervisors, and management will interact with the system according to their roles, enabling efficient workflows such as leave applications, approvals, attendance corrections, and report generation.

This solution supports Kalinaw Trading Corporation's operational requirements by automating routine HR tasks, enforcing role-based access controls, and providing timely notifications and audit trails. The system's design accommodates the company's organizational structure and policies, ensuring compliance and facilitating seamless integration with existing payroll systems.
technical_architecture: The HRIS is architected as a cloud-deployed microservices platform utilizing Java with Spring Boot for backend services, React for the frontend interface, and PostgreSQL as the data store. The system includes separate environments for development, testing (UAT), and production to ensure quality and stability.

Integration with external payroll systems is managed through well-defined interfaces, and the architecture supports scalability to handle up to 300 concurrent users with high availability targets. Security is enforced through role-based access control, audit trails, and data privacy measures, aligning with the client's requirements for secure and reliable HR operations.
warranty_support: A warranty period will follow the system's go-live, during which any defects or issues identified will be promptly addressed and corrected at no additional cost. Defects can be reported through a defined support channel, ensuring timely resolution and minimal disruption to operations.

The warranty covers all functionalities delivered as part of the project scope. Support for enhancements, additional features, or issues arising from changes outside the agreed scope will be offered as separate service options, allowing Kalinaw Trading Corporation to tailor ongoing support to their evolving needs.
